_comment: Two-turn conversations whose second question only makes sense after the first. Written and frozen on 2026-11-17, before any rewrite or answer run. The evidence is for the second question; every passage was copied from the documents and checked to appear in them exactly. Used to measure whether rewriting a follow-up into a stand-alone question helps retrieval.

turns: How much does the Pro plan cost per month?
How do I suspend a member?

evidence.text: but they keep their role, their project memberships, and their task assignments

turns: What does the IP allowlist do?

evidence.text: On the Pro plan, Admins can limit sign-ins and API requests to a list of IP address ranges

turns: How long do you keep our support conversations?
Can we have them deleted sooner?

evidence.text: A customer can ask for its support conversations to be deleted sooner.

turns: How do I require two-factor authentication for everyone?

evidence.text: Only authenticator apps are supported; SMS codes are not.

turns: What is the API rate limit on the Basic plan?
Which response header shows how many requests are left?

evidence.text: | X-RateLimit-Remaining | How many requests are left in the current window |

turns: Where is our organization's data stored?

evidence.text: It is shown under Settings > Organization > General and can't be changed.

turns: How do I check that a delivery really came from you?

evidence.text: Every delivery is signed, so your endpoint can check that it came from us and wasn't replayed.
